title: Quantum Patches: Enhancing Robustness of Quantum Machine Learning Models
summary: Machine learning models and their applications, such as autonomous driving systems, are becoming increasingly common and are essential components of human daily life. However, due to their sensitivity to perturbed noise, these models are easily susceptible to adversarial attacks. Not only are classical machine learning models affected, but quantum machine learning (QML) models have also been proven to be vulnerable to adversarial attacks, which degrade their performance.
